mentions.name: ZAEL
mentions.description: This app is a browser-based mage arena game for smartphone and desktop supporting 1 to 4 players with no login or installation required. Players can share a link to invite others into their game across platforms, and it is built with phaser.js and three.js.
mentions.source_excerpt: It is called ZAEL. It is a mage arena web app (smartphone/Desktop), played from 1 to 4 players, no login, easy to share a link to invite people into your game, whatever the platform. It is no install, no bullshit. Just click and play
